pay.title: You pay as usual
pay.body: You use your bank as usual and get its notification.

reads.title: Wambito reads it on your phone
reads.body: The notification text never leaves your phone. Only the transaction does: the amount, the merchant, the date and the app.

decide.body: It leaves you a notice with OK and Change. The expense already counts in your month, marked “to review”.

next.title: Today and what's next

open_source.title: Open source
open_source.body: Anyone can read Wambito's code: nothing in it is hidden. It's free software, licensed under the AGPL-3.0.

what.a: An app for your monthly budget that doesn't feel like homework. You log what you spend, see what's left in each category, and Wambi, a gold coin with plenty of personality, keeps you company: it cheers when you log something and gives you a heads-up when a category is filling up.

import.q: Can I bring my history from other apps?
import.a: Yes. Today you can import from Budge: export your transactions as a CSV and upload it when you sign up or later from Settings. Buddy and other apps are coming soon. Before anything is imported you see a preview: how many transactions come in, which ones are duplicates and which categories will be created.

passwords.q: Why doesn't it ask for a password?
passwords.a: Because you don't need one. You sign in with a 6-digit code or a link sent to your email and, if you like, with a passkey: your fingerprint, your face or your phone's screen lock. No password to remember.

privacy.q: What do you do with my data?
privacy.a: Your data travels encrypted, and we never sell it or share it with advertisers. You can export it or delete your account whenever you want. The code is open source: anyone can read the code that handles it. The details are in the <privacy>privacy policy</privacy>.

free.a: Yes, and it always will be. Wambito is free and open source: all the code is on <github>GitHub</github> for anyone to read. We never ask for a card.

languages.a: Spanish, English, Italian and Portuguese. Switch whenever you like in Settings, and amounts and dates follow your language's format.

closing.title: Ready when you are.
closing.body: Create your account with your email in under a minute. Wambito takes care of making it fun.
closing.body_soon: Wambito is being built in the open. Follow its progress on GitHub and try the app as soon as it opens.

meta.title: Wambito · Privacy policy
meta.description: How Wambito handles your data: what it stores, where, who can see it and how to ask us to delete it.

controller.title: Who is responsible for your data
controller.body: Wambito belongs to Slinqer S.A.S., a Colombian company. Slinqer S.A.S. is the controller of your data under Colombia's Ley 1581 de 2012 (its data protection law). This policy covers wambito.com, app.wambito.com and the Android app when it uses our server. For any question about your data, write to <email>privacy@wambito.com</email>.

data.title: What we store
data.body: Your email. Your passkeys, only their public part: the private key stays on your device. What you log or import: transactions, categories, budgets and recurring items. Your time zone and language. If you connect an AI assistant, the permission you gave it. And, for security, the IP address and the kind of browser or app of each session, plus a minimal log of visits: when, from which IP, which page and how it answered. That log keeps neither what comes after the “?” in addresses nor the headers.

purposes.title: Why we store it
purposes.body: Your email, so you can sign in with a code or a link, and so we can answer if you write to us. Passkeys, so you can sign in without a password. Your transactions, categories, budgets and recurring items, to show you your budget: that is what the app is for. The time zone, to know when your day and your month start. The language, to speak yours, in the app and in emails. The IP and sessions, to keep your account safe and stop abuse, such as asking for codes nonstop. Sign-in emails go out through an email delivery service, which only gets your address and the message.

storage.title: Where it is stored
storage.body: On a server in the European Union. Your data travels encrypted between your device and the server. Every day we make a backup on the server and keep another copy, encrypted with age, in Cloudflare R2. No backup lasts more than 14 days: after that it deletes itself. So if you delete your account, it also leaves the backups within 14 days at most.

not_done.title: What we don't do
not_done.body: No trackers, no analytics, no ads. We don't sell your data or share it. It only passes through the services we need to run (the server, the backups and email delivery), and only for that.

voice.title: Your voice
voice.body: In the Android app you can dictate an expense. Your voice is processed on your phone, with Vosk, and the audio never leaves it. The voice models are downloaded once, when you ask for them, from the project's releases on GitHub. Only the transaction you save reaches our server, as if you had typed it.

capture.title: Automatic capture
capture.body: In the Android app you can turn on automatic capture: it starts off. If you turn it on and give Wambito access to notifications, it reads only those of the apps you choose, Revolut and Google Wallet, and ignores every other one. The notification text is processed on the phone and never leaves your phone: we neither store it nor send it. Only the transaction taken from it reaches our server: the amount and currency, the merchant, the date and time, and the app it came from. It arrives marked “to review”, and you can confirm, change or delete it. To suggest the category, we remember the one you gave each merchant. You can turn it off at any time in Settings → Automatic capture, or remove Wambito's access to notifications in Android's settings.

assistants.title: AI assistants
assistants.body: You can connect an AI assistant to your account. It only gets in if you allow it, on a permission screen (OAuth) that tells you what it will be able to do: read your data, log things for you, or both. You can take its access away whenever you like, in Settings. What the assistant reads is handled by the company that offers it, under its own policy.

guest.title: Without an email: guest mode
guest.body: In the Android app you can start without an email. Your data is stored on the server, in a guest account. If you add your email later, you keep it. A guest account left unused for 60 days is deleted with all its data, even if you signed out.

self_hosted.title: If you use another server
self_hosted.body: Wambito's code is open source and anyone can run their own server. If your app uses a server that isn't ours, whoever runs it is the controller of your data there, not Slinqer S.A.S. This policy only covers the servers we run.

rights.title: Your rights
rights.body: Under Ley 1581 de 2012, you can know what data we hold about you, update it, correct it, ask us to delete it and withdraw your consent. To do so, write to <email>privacy@wambito.com</email> from your account's email. Many things you can do without writing to us: download your data in Settings or <link>delete your account</link>. If you are not satisfied with our answer, you can turn to Colombia's Superintendencia de Industria y Comercio.

changes.title: Changes to this policy
changes.body: If we change this policy, we publish the new version here with its date. The date at the top is that of the version in force.

meta.title: Wambito · Delete your account
meta.description: How to delete your Wambito account and the data it holds, from the app or by email.

in_app.title: From the app
in_app.body: On the web or in the Android app, go to Settings and choose “Delete my account”. To confirm, we ask you to type your email. If you like, download your data first: the button is right there. If you use the app as a guest, save your progress with an email first; otherwise your account deletes itself after 60 days unused.

by_email.title: By email
by_email.body: If you can't sign in, write to <email>privacy@wambito.com</email> from your account's email and ask us to delete it. We'll let you know when it's done.

what_goes.title: What is deleted
what_goes.body: Everything in your account, right away: your account, your email, your passkeys and sessions, your transactions, categories, budgets and recurring items, and the permissions of the assistants you connected. On the phone, the app also clears what it kept of your account.

backups.title: Backups
backups.body: Backups that include your account delete themselves within 14 days at most. The copy that leaves the server is encrypted. There are more details in the <link>privacy policy</link>.
